title: Delivered
description: A frame delivered on a channel, its payload a P, what the channel carries: with its envelope, who emitted it and the trace it was sent under, each absent when the frame carries none.

payload.description: The frame's payload, as its channel's typed read gives it.

scope.description: The resource scope it was published on; absent when it names none.

userId.description: Who emitted it: the user the gateway stamped on its payload (bus/registry.json `stamps`).

trace.description: The trace it was sent under (bus/registry.json `trace`).
